meta.description:
A ceremonial instrument-house built around sound, weather, and astronomical measurement. Its rooms form a slow rising procession from a grounded entry court to a luminous upper
    observatory.

layout.description:
A ceremonial instrument-house built around sound, weather, and astronomical measurement. Its rooms form a slow rising procession from a grounded entry court to a luminous upper
    observatory.

rooms.name: Threshold Court
rooms.style: A compressed arrival chamber of dark basalt-like superquadric benches, low plinths, and a single directional beacon. Its forms should feel heavy, tactile, and deliberately quiet before the larger spaces beyond.

rooms.name: Brass Gallery
rooms.style: A long exhibit hall for gleaming brass measuring devices, nested rings, and weighted counterbalances. Furnish it with warm metallic superquadric assemblies arranged as a formal procession.

rooms.name: Sun Lantern Hall
rooms.style: A tall warm chamber centered on suspended lamp-like assemblies and faceted reflective dishes. Use amber glass, gold metal, and softly rounded architectural forms that make it feel like an indoor sunrise.

rooms.name: Processional Spine
rooms.style: A narrow northward corridor lined with repeated stone ribs, shallow niches, and occasional bell-shaped markers. The superquadric composition should emphasize rhythm and forward movement.

rooms.name: Echo Chamber
rooms.style: A square acoustic laboratory filled with drum-like bodies, curved resonators, and clustered tuning weights. Materials should be charcoal ceramic and muted copper, with forms placed to suggest sound waves crossing the room.
